item.title: Professor Layton and The New World of Steam: 2026 Release, PS5 Expansion, and Story Details Explained
item.description: Level-5 officially confirmed Professor Layton and The New World of Steam will launch globally in 2026 across the Nintendo Switch, the Switch 2, PlayStation 5, and PC via Steam.

item.title: Nintendo Launches Free 'Hello, Yoshi!' App for Kids: Everything Parents Need to Know
item.description: Nintendo officially released the free Hello, Yoshi! app on April 9 across the Nintendo Switch, iOS, and Android platforms.

item.title: IShowSpeed Anime Series: 'One Piece' Writer Matt Owens Leads Big Shot Pictures Project
item.description: YouTube star Darren Jason Watkins Jr., widely known to audiences as IShowSpeed, is officially entering the animation industry.

item.title: Jam Kuradoberi Joins Guilty Gear -Strive-: Starter Guide Breakdown & Season 5 Launch
item.description: Arc System Works dropped the official Jam Kuradoberi starter guide ahead of the highly anticipated Guilty Gear -Strive- Season 5.

item.title: Shuten Order Physical Release Delayed for Switch and Switch 2 in North America
item.description: North American fans waiting to secure a boxed copy of Shuten Order will need to hold out one extra week.

item.title: Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream Brings Part-Time Jobs and Inclusive Romance to the Switch
item.description: Nintendo’s Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream officially launches on the Nintendo Switch on April 16, 2026, bringing part-time jobs, expansive Mii customization, and fully inclusive romance options to the beloved island simulator.

item.title: Silent Hill f Manga Announced: Ryukishi07 Promises a Brand New Ending
item.description: Konami is celebrating the six-month anniversary of Silent Hill f with a brand-new manga adaptation.

item.title: Official Okami 20th Anniversary Project Teased for April 2026: New Game Updates Expected
item.description: Capcom has officially confirmed that multiple 20th-anniversary projects are in the works for the Okami franchise, with a major reveal expected around April 20, 2026.

item.title: Toei Launches "Kamen Rider Animated" Label With Aniplex and Shirogumi
item.description: Toei has officially established “The Kamen Rider Animated,” a new production label dedicated entirely to anime feature films based on the iconic tokusatsu franchise.

item.title: Another Eden Begins: Release Date, Switch 2 Confirmation, and New Game+ Details
item.description: Another Eden Begins will officially launch on September 17, 2026, for the Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).

item.title: Tales of 30th Anniversary: ufotable and Production I.G Announce 188 New Illustrations
item.description: The legendary “Tales of” RPG franchise is celebrating its 30th anniversary with a massive artistic collaboration.

item.title: Shizuku Murasaki DLC Release Date Revealed for Hunter x Hunter Nen x Impact
item.description: Shizuku Murasaki is officially joining the Hunter x Hunter Nen x Impact roster as the third Season 1 DLC character on April 16, 2026.

item.title: Kantai Collection Developer C2 Kikan Announces Ki-gō Keikaku: 3D Mecha RPG for PC and Mobile
item.description: C2 Kikan (also operating as C2Architecture), the development studio behind the industry-defining mega-hit Kantai Collection, is officially developing Ki-gō Keikaku (Plan Number Ki).

item.title: Gachiakuta: The Game, Combat Trailers, Co-Op Gameplay, and Character Roster Explained
item.description: Com2uS has officially released a series of new combat trailers for GACHIAKUTA: The Game, showcasing the unique, fast-paced fighting styles of playable characters Rudo, Enjin, Riyo, and Zanka.

item.title: Wobble Wobble: The Bird-Based Bomb Disposal Sim Hitting Steam This April
item.description: Indie developer Team Baeb Sae is officially launching Wobble Wobble, a high-tension, physics-based bomb disposal puzzle game, on Steam on April 9, 2026.
